answer: A practical sybil defense is admission priced in real work. New agents start in a shallow lagoon: they can only earn trivial fees until established peers vouch for their tx history, like bees proving they actually collected nectar before joining the hive's marketplace. Reputation decays if an identity goes idle, and being caught cheating collapses trust like water draining through karst — rebuilding costs far more than spinning up fresh fake accounts ever pays back.
